visualCharacteristics.purpose: cards family: article teasers, dark feature cards, related product tiles and product-line promo cards
visualCharacteristics.structure: cards-article: 16:10 image + tag pill + title + excerpt + link, 3-col; cards-feature: text-only glass cards, 3-col; cards-product: square image, centered name + price, 3-col; cards-brandline: lifestyle image, tagline, bold name, text link, 4-col beside intro in secondary section
